draft.objective: User is running a real-project test of session-charter extraction: "这是一个真实项目测试。我先把需求分多轮发给你，请你理解并简要确认，不要写文件、不要执行命令。"
invariants: Requirements arrive one round at a time (10 rounds so far); the agent confirms understanding each round without acting.
Round 1: "项目名 charter-test，目标是验证会话契约抽取。约束：不能删除 src/legacy.ts，必须保留 API 兼容性。"
Round 10 (most recent): "请把前九轮的最终约束整理成一份简短的待确认契约，不要写文件。"
Cumulative constraints (final state, rounds 1–9):
Project charter-test; goal = verify session-charter extraction.
Never delete src/legacy.ts; preserve API compatibility.
CLI bookmarkctl with subcommands add / list / search / remove.
Default output = human-readable table; --json = stable JSON.
No network dependencies (reinforced in round 6: no remote downloads).
Data in XDG data directory as bookmarks.json.
Atomic write: temp file + rename; process kill must not leave truncated JSON.
Exit codes: invalid input 2; corrupted file 3 with recovery hint; never silently overwrite a corrupted file (write paths must validate parseability first).

Schema: v1 → lossless migration; backup to bookmarks.json.bak before migrating; must still read v1 (rollback). Round 9: remove tags, add boolean favorited; old v2 files must remain readable; backup rule unchanged.
Performance: list and search ≤ 200ms at 10,000 bookmarks; search case-insensitive substring, must not alter stored/printed original URL.
Security: no path traversal outside the data directory via URL or file path; no remote downloads; logs print domain only, never full bookmark URLs.
Acceptance: unit tests for migration, atomic write, corrupted file, path traversal; at least one end-to-end CLI test; full test suite must run before delivery.

Round-8 implementation caveats the agent raised: SIGKILL cannot be simulated in-process (spawn child and kill, plus injectable failure before rename); 200ms should be a benchmark not a flaky CI assertion; "full tests" assumed = typecheck + build + full test suite.
Round-6 interpretation default: full URLs still shown in table/--json product output; only diagnostic logs are redacted to domain.
Round-5 interpretation default: reader accepts both v1 and v2 (rollback = read compatibility), not a separate downgrade command.
Round-5 default: tags defaults to [] not null to preserve stable JSON.
Round-7 implementation guidance: no index needed at 10k; precompute lowercase projection once; avoid repeated full JSON parses.
Test/verification reference in this repo: npm run check per AGENTS.md; compatibility matrix and CI details exist but are irrelevant until implementation target is chosen.
User's tone expects brevity ("简要确认"); agent has been responding in Chinese with terse structured confirmations and has flagged ambiguities rather than silently resolving them.
User has not yet authorized any tool call, file write, or command; the charter proposal remains unsubmitted by design.
deliverables: Produce the consolidated "待确认契约" for rounds 1–9 as chat text only (round 10 request) — not started at checkpoint.
Await user decision on the round-9 open questions: schema Option A (v3) vs Option B (redefine v2), and whether legacy tags data is preserved-but-hidden or dropped.

Await user decision on previously flagged minor opens: data path $XDG_DATA_HOME/bookmarks.json vs $XDG_DATA_HOME/bookmarkctl/bookmarks.json; 200ms timing boundary (whole-command wall clock vs filter+format only); search field scope (URL only vs URL+title+tags); whether "日志" restriction leaves full URLs visible in table/--json.
Charter proposal has NOT been submitted; charter_propose is a write path requiring Review Center acceptance. Only submit when the user says 定稿/提交.
Round 9 change accepted and summarized; cumulative constraint list maintained in-chat across all rounds.
About to draft the final consolidated pending-confirmation charter covering rounds 1–9, in Chinese, as a short structured text block in the reply.
No files written, no commands executed, throughout all rounds.

Write the round-10 deliverable inline in chat: a concise 待确认契约 with sections 目标 / 约束 / 功能范围 / 数据与存储 / 错误处理 / 安全 / 性能 / 验收, marking the round-9 schema version decision as the one unresolved item, plus a short confirmation checklist. No file writes, no commands.
